# Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from 'lazysubmodules status -h'; do not edit.

Usage: lazysubmodules status [<name>...] [--porcelain=v1]

Show the tracking configuration, the lock entry, the checked-out commit and
the state of submodules: ok, behind, drift, dirty, uninitialized,
missing-ref or unmanaged. Without names, every submodule is shown,
including unmanaged ones. Only local refs are consulted; run 'fetch' first
to see what the remotes offer.

Options:
  --porcelain[=v1]  print the stable v1 format for scripts instead of a table
